metadata.name: celestial_perps
metadata.description: Celestial Perps — pool-counterparty perpetuals on Solana

accounts.name: user_state
docs: Created on the fly for holders who received CLP by transfer (never added liquidity).

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: Signer is not the pending admin

errors.name: InvalidMarketAccounts
errors.msg: Remaining accounts must list every market and its oracle in config order

errors.name: OracleMismatch
errors.msg: Oracle account does not match the market

errors.name: InvalidOracleOwner
errors.msg: Oracle account is not owned by the Chainlink store program

errors.name: InvalidOracleData
errors.msg: Oracle account data could not be decoded

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ReserveExceedsPool
errors.msg: Reserved amount would exceed pool amount

errors.name: UnsupportedOracleKind
errors.msg: Oracle kind is not supported by this build

errors.name: InvalidNonce
errors.msg: Request nonce does not match the user's next nonce

errors.name: RequestMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not match the request

errors.name: InvalidPosition
errors.msg: Position account does not match the expected PDA

errors.name: InsufficientRequestLamports
errors.msg: Execution fee lamports missing from the request account

types.name: CancelReason
docs: Why a request was cancelled during execution (emitted in `RequestCancelled.reason`).
Mirrors the EVM custom errors that cause a cancel in `PerpEngine.executeRequests`.

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration and engine parameters (mirror of PerpEngine.sol state).

types.name: OracleKind
docs: Where a market's price comes from. `Mock` is only readable when the program is built with
the `mock-oracle` feature (local tests); the devnet build rejects it.

types.name: ParamsUpdate
docs: Every field is optional; only the given ones change. Bounds are the EVM setter bounds.

types.name: Pool
docs: LP pool accounting. All USDC sits in one vault owned by this PDA.

fields.name: realised_pnl
docs: Profit capped by the reserve; losses uncapped.

types.name: Request
docs: Pending order. Holds `execution_fee` (+ `position_rent`) lamports on top of its own rent;

fields.name: position_rent
docs: Lamports prepaid by the trader for the `Position` account's rent (increase requests
when the position does not exist yet); used to create it on execution, else refunded.
